text: Oncology is a clinical medical discipline that studies the mechanisms of tumor occurrence and development, diagnostic techniques, treatment strategies, and preventive management. The course centers on "precision diagnosis and treatment" and "full-process management", covering the fundamentals of tumor biology, multimodal diagnosis, individualized treatment, and interdisciplinary collaboration. It aims to cultivate students' mastery of tumor molecular pathological characteristics, standardized treatment principles (such as NCCN guidelines), and clinical research thinking. Have the ability to independently handle common tumors (such as lung cancer, breast cancer, and colorectal cancer) and deal with complex cases (such as oligometastasis and drug resistance recurrence).
